detail.title: GS350 2.1 Stereo Desktop Speakers with LED Lights
detail.overview: The Ant Esports GS350 is a 2.1 channel powered desktop speaker system that combines a dedicated subwoofer with stereo satellites for deep bass and clear vocals across games, movies and music. A simple 3.5mm AUX input connects instantly to a PC, laptop, tablet or phone, while USB powers the whole set without extra adapters. An in-line volume control lets you adjust loudness on the fly without reaching behind the unit, and built-in LED lighting adds a colourful accent to any desk setup. Compact and easy to place, it's a straightforward multimedia speaker upgrade for everyday computing and casual entertainment.
